title: Practice Exam 2
description: 10 free-response challenges across Electric Vehicles, Libraries, Robotics, Accounting, Gastronomy, Automotive, Instrumentation, Networking, Finance, and Space Exploration themes.

questions.title: EV Charging Station
questions.prompt:
Create a class `EVStation` in `EVStation.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String stationId`, `String city`, `int totalPorts`, `double pricePerKWh`.
* **Constructor 1:** `EVStation(String stationId, String city, int totalPorts, double pricePerKWh)`.
* **Constructor 2:** `EVStation(String stationId, String city)` which assigns `totalPorts = 4` and `pricePerKWh = 0.35`.
* **Getters and Setters:** For all four fields.
  * In `setTotalPorts(int totalPorts)`: Must have at least 1 port and at most 32. If `< 1`, set to `1`. If `> 32`, set to `32`.
  * In `setPricePerKWh(double price)`: If `< 0.05`, set to `0.05`.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Default constructor fields; port upper clamp (50 -> 32); minimum price clamp (0.01 -> 0.05).

questions.title: Library Catalog Book
questions.prompt:
Create a class `CatalogBook` in `CatalogBook.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String isbn`, `String title`, `int publicationYear`.
* **Constructor:** `CatalogBook(String isbn, String title, int publicationYear)`.
* **`toString()`:** Return:
  ```
  ISBN: <isbn>
  Title: <title>
  Year: <publicationYear>
  ```
  *(Separated by `\n` with no trailing newline)*
* **`equals(Object o)`:** Two catalog books are equal if their `isbn` matches **exactly (case-sensitive)**. Return `false` if `o` is `null` or not an instance of `CatalogBook`.

ISBN: 978-0134685991
Title: Effective Java
Year: 2018
Same ISBN: true

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Multi-line output format and equality based solely on matching ISBN.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Different ISBN)
tests.description: Same title and year, different ISBN returns false.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
ISBN: 978-0134685991
Title: Effective Java
Year: 2018
Same ISBN: true

questions.title: Drone Altitude Guard
questions.prompt:
Create an unchecked exception `CeilingExceededException` in `CeilingExceededException.java` that extends `RuntimeException` with a constructor taking `String message`.

In `DroneController.java`, implement:
`public static int climb(int currentAltitude, int delta, int maxCeiling) throws CeilingExceededException`
* If `delta <= 0`, throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message: `"Climb delta must be positive"`.
* If `currentAltitude + delta > maxCeiling`, throw `CeilingExceededException` with message:
  `"Ceiling violated: attempted <currentAltitude + delta>m, ceiling is <maxCeiling>m"`.
* Otherwise, return `currentAltitude + delta`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Altitude: 90m
Ceiling violated: attempted 140m, ceiling is 120m

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Starting at Ceiling)
tests.description: Any positive climb from maxCeiling throws CeilingExceededException.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Altitude: 90m
Ceiling violated: attempted 140m, ceiling is 120m

questions.title: Taxable Asset
questions.prompt:
Create an interface `Taxable` in `Taxable.java`:
* Abstract method: `double getMarketValue();`
* Default method: `default double calculateTax(double propertyTaxRate)`:
  * If `propertyTaxRate < 0.0 || propertyTaxRate > 0.20`, return `0.0`.
  * Otherwise, return `getMarketValue() * propertyTaxRate`.
* Default method: `default boolean isHighValue()`: returns `true` if `getMarketValue() >= 500000.0`, else `false`.

Create a class `RealEstate` in `RealEstate.java` that implements `Taxable`:
* **Private field:** `double estimatedValue`.
* **Constructor:** `RealEstate(double estimatedValue)`.
* Implement `getMarketValue()` returning `estimatedValue`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Value: $600000.00
Tax at 2%: $12000.00
High Value: true
Invalid Tax Rate: 0.0

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: High value asset, valid tax, invalid out-of-range tax rate (>0.20).

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Polymorphic Reference)
tests.description: Taxable t = new RealEstate(200000.0); calls default methods properly.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Value: $600000.00
Tax at 2%: $12000.00
High Value: true
Invalid Tax Rate: 0.0

questions.title: Culinary Recipe Subclasses
questions.prompt:
Create a class `Recipe` in `Recipe.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String name`, `int prepTimeMinutes`.
* **Constructor:** `Recipe(String name, int prepTimeMinutes)`.
* Method `getTotalTime()` returning `prepTimeMinutes`.

Create subclass `BakedRecipe` in `BakedRecipe.java` extending `Recipe`:
* **Private fields:** `int bakeTimeMinutes`, `int ovenTempFahrenheit`.
* **Constructor:** `BakedRecipe(String name, int prepTimeMinutes, int bakeTimeMinutes, int ovenTempFahrenheit)` using `super`.
* Override `getTotalTime()`:
  * Sum `prepTimeMinutes + bakeTimeMinutes`.
  * If `ovenTempFahrenheit > 400`, add `10` minutes for preheating.
questions.expectedOutput:
Caesar Salad: 15 mins
Choc Chip: 32 mins
Pan Pizza: 60 mins

questions.title: Fleet Carbon Footprint
questions.prompt:
Given base class `Vehicle` with method `double getEmissions()` and subclass `HybridVehicle` (which overrides `getEmissions()` applying a battery fuel offset), implement `FleetAnalyzer.java`:
* `public static double calculateTotalEmissions(Vehicle[] fleet)`:
  * Sums `getEmissions()` across all non-null vehicles.
  * If `fleet` is `null` or empty, return `0.0`.
* `public static int countZeroEmissionVehicles(Vehicle[] fleet)`:
  * Returns how many non-null vehicles have `getEmissions() <= 0.0`.
  * If `fleet` is `null`, return `0`.

*(The autograder provides `Vehicle` and `HybridVehicle`.)*

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Mixed fleet with null, standard vehicle, and zero-emission hybrid.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Null Fleet)
tests.description: Passing null to either method returns 0.0 or 0.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (All Zero Emission)
tests.description: All hybrid vehicles netting 0.0 returns total fleet length.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Negative Emission Guard)
tests.description: Hybrid where battery offset exceeds emissions returns 0.0.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Polymorphic Method Call)
tests.description: Dynamic dispatch verified on overridden methods.

questions.title: Sensor Stream Min-Max
questions.prompt:
In `SensorDataReader.java`, write:
`public static double findSensorRange(String filename) throws FileNotFoundException`
* The file contains comma-separated reading lines: `SensorId,ReadingValue`
  Example: `TEMP-A,98.6`
* The first line is a header (`SensorId,ReadingValue`) and must be skipped.
* Find the maximum reading and the minimum reading among all rows.
* Return the range: `maxReading - minReading`.
* If the file has no data rows (only the header), return `0.0`.
* If the file does not exist, throw `FileNotFoundException`. Ensure resources are closed.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Single Row Data)
tests.description: Single reading row has max == min, returns 0.0.

questions.title: High Latency Network Reporter
questions.prompt:
In `LatencyReporter.java`, write:
`public static int exportHighLatencyPings(String inputFile, String outputFile, int thresholdMs)`
* `inputFile` is pipe-delimited: `ServerHostname|IP|PingMs`
  Example: `east.purdue.edu|128.210.11.1|48`
* Filter servers where `PingMs >= thresholdMs`.
* Write to `outputFile`, one per line:
  `SLOW: <ServerHostname> (<PingMs>ms)`
* Return total slow servers written.
* If `inputFile` is missing, catch `IOException`, print `"Network file error"`, and return `-1`.

*(Remember to split on the regex `\\|`.)*

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Exact Threshold)
tests.description: Server with PingMs == thresholdMs is exported.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (All Exceed)
tests.description: All rows written; returns total count.

tests.name: Test 8 [Hidden] (Resource Flush)
tests.description: Validates all lines flushed to disk.

questions.title: Bank Loan Hierarchy
questions.prompt:
Create abstract class `Loan` in `Loan.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `double principal`, `double annualInterestRate`.
* **Constructor:** `Loan(double principal, double annualInterestRate)`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract double calculateTotalRepayment(int years);`

Create subclass `PersonalLoan` in `PersonalLoan.java`:
* **Constructor:** `PersonalLoan(double principal, double annualInterestRate)`.
* Formula: Simple interest: `principal + (principal * annualInterestRate * years)`.

Create subclass `MortgageLoan` in `MortgageLoan.java`:
* **Private field:** `double originationFee`.
* **Constructor:** `MortgageLoan(double principal, double annualInterestRate, double originationFee)` using `super`.
* Formula: Simple interest + origination fee: `principal + (principal * annualInterestRate * years) + originationFee`.
  * If `years >= 30`, apply a long-term closing discount: subtract `$1000.0` from repayment.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Personal simple interest and mortgage with 30-year discount.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (29-Year Mortgage)
tests.description: 29-year mortgage does NOT get the $1000 discount.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Zero Years)
tests.description: Repayment at 0 years equals principal (plus fee for mortgage).

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Super Constructor)
tests.description: Principal and interest properly initialized in superclass.

tests.name: Test 8 [Hidden] (High Principal Calculation)
tests.description: Large mortgage values calculate without precision failure.

questions.title: Mars Rover Mission Controller
questions.prompt:
Simulate a planetary exploration rover in `RoverController.java`. Rover starts at `Battery: 100`% and `Samples Collected: 0`.

Each round: print `Battery: <battery>% | Samples: <samples>`, display menu:
`1) Traverse Terrain (-15% Bat)  2) Drill Rock Sample (-25% Bat, +1 Sample)  3) Recharge Solar (+30% Bat)  4) Transmit & Shutdown`
* `1`: Subtract 15% battery.
* `2`: If battery < 25%, print `Low power: cannot drill sample!`. Otherwise subtract 25% battery and add 1 sample.
* `3`: Add 30% battery. Battery cannot exceed `100%` (capped at 100).
* `4`: Print `Mission complete. Collected <samples> samples.` and terminate.
* **Any other input:** Print `Unknown command: rover idle. (-5% Bat)` and subtract 5% battery.
* **Failure Condition:** If `Battery <= 0%` at any time, immediately print `BATTERY DEPLETED: Rover lost on Mars.` and terminate.

Read menu choices from standard input with a `Scanner`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Battery: 100% | Samples: 0
1) Traverse Terrain (-15% Bat)  2) Drill Rock Sample (-25% Bat, +1 Sample)  3) Recharge Solar (+30% Bat)  4) Transmit & Shutdown
Battery: 85% | Samples: 0
1) Traverse Terrain (-15% Bat)  2) Drill Rock Sample (-25% Bat, +1 Sample)  3) Recharge Solar (+30% Bat)  4) Transmit & Shutdown
Battery: 60% | Samples: 1
1) Traverse Terrain (-15% Bat)  2) Drill Rock Sample (-25% Bat, +1 Sample)  3) Recharge Solar (+30% Bat)  4) Transmit & Shutdown
Battery: 90% | Samples: 1
1) Traverse Terrain (-15% Bat)  2) Drill Rock Sample (-25% Bat, +1 Sample)  3) Recharge Solar (+30% Bat)  4) Transmit & Shutdown
Mission complete. Collected 1 samples.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Traverse, drill sample, solar recharge, transmission exit.

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Drill Denied Under 25%)
tests.description: Battery at 20% attempting to drill prints message and retains 20% battery and sample count.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Depletion in Traverse)
tests.description: Traverse causing battery <= 0 prints depletion message and exits.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Depletion in Idle)
tests.description: Unknown command dropping battery <= 0 prints depletion message and terminates.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Drill with Exact 25%)
tests.description: Battery at 25% drills successfully, leaving 0% battery which immediately triggers depletion.

tests.name: Test 8 [Hidden] (Immediate Shutdown)
tests.description: Option 4 on turn 1 exits with 0 samples.

tests.name: Test 9 [Hidden] (Repeated Recharge)
tests.description: Recharging multiple times stays locked at 100%.
